optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Fraud Analytics Analyst, Card Fraud Detection
professionalSummary: Fraud analytics analyst with three years of experience in a card issuer's fraud detection team, specializing in analysing flagged-transaction outcomes, proposing rule threshold changes with expected alert volumes, and coordinating with stakeholders.
experienceHighlights: Analysed flagged-transaction outcomes weekly and proposed rule threshold changes with expected alert volumes; changes approved by the fraud strategy manager.
Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of rule changes.
Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on a weekly dashboard and raised two drift cases to model owners, recorded in the model monitoring log.
Coordinated rule changes with the fraud operations desk through change notes, documenting responsibility boundaries.
Wrote limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each rule change note.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: rule change proposal with expected alert volumes and approval record; monthly fraud performance pack; model monitoring log extract for two drift cases, with fraud tool references as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience and responsibilities related to rule analysis, performance reporting, model monitoring, coordination with the fraud operations desk, and documentation of rule change boundaries. They do not provide evidence of any additional responsibilities, quantitative metrics beyond those stated, or evidence of leadership or ownership beyond the described tasks.

evidence.text: Fraud analytics analyst in a card issuer's fraud detection team for three years, analysing flagged-transaction outcomes each week and proposing rule threshold changes with their expected alert volumes; the changes were approved by the fraud strategy manager.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of analysis and proposal of rule changes with expected volumes.

evidence.text: Prepared the monthly fraud performance pack for the fraud strategy manager, covering fraud losses, alert volumes, false positive rates and the effect of the month's rule changes.

evidence.text: Monitored the fraud model's alert precision on the weekly monitoring dashboard and raised two drift cases to the model owners, both recorded in the model monitoring log.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of monitoring and raising drift cases.

evidence.text: Coordinated each rule change with the fraud operations desk through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which belonged to the desk supervisor.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of coordination and responsibility recording.

evidence.text: Wrote the limitation section of each rule change note and the hand-over conditions for the desk.
